title: Stakeholder Alignment Deck Templates (Standard + Enterprise Tracks)
content:
Purpose: quick, reusable deck templates + facilitator notes for quarterly customer reviews. Two parallel tracks in one package: a lightweight operational "Standard" track for day-to-day users / SMB+growth customers, and a richer "Enterprise" track combining executive narrative + technical appendix. This file is a working draft — rough talk tracks, placeholders, and a compact renewal tracker.

Top-level approach (notes to self):
- Use Standard track for accounts with ARR < $200k or teams where the executive sponsor won't join. Keep to 30 minutes.
- Use Enterprise track for >$200k ARR or strategic customers; split into Exec (30m) + Tech breakout (30m) or a single 60m slot if needed.
- Prep checklist (3 business days before): pull L30/L90 usage, top 10 API endpoints by calls, incident log, recent support tickets tagged 'blocker', active roadmap items mapped to customer asks.

1) Standard Track (Operational / Customer Success run) — 20–30 minutes
Slide 1: Welcome & Agenda (1 slide)
- 2 bullets: who, what we’ll cover, desired outcome (decide next steps + renewal timeline)
- Talking note: explicit ask near top: "Primary decision needed: renewal timing & pilot expansion go/no-go"

Slide 2: Quick Health Snapshot (visual 1 page)
- Recommended: 3-lane sparkline: usage trend (30-day tokens), error-rate %, latency p95
- One-sentence commentary: "Adoption stable/growing/slipping — main driver = X"

Slide 3: Success highlights (2–4 bullets)
- Recent wins: feature adoption, support SLAs met, cost savings examples
- Short customer quote (if available) or placeholder: "Customer engineering: \"reduced inference cost by 28%\""

Slide 4: Risks & Blockers (bullet list + owner)
- Example: "KV cache flush caused latency spikes (owner: support)"
- Escalation trigger: if >3 incidents in 30 days or latency >500ms p95 across three days

Slide 5: Renewal & Expansion Ask (single slide)
- Current contract snapshot (term, renewal date, committed GPUs or tokens) — populate in prep
- Recommended motion: renew (yes/no/conditional) + top expansion ask (e.g., dedicated pool trial)
- Call to action: sign-off owner + date

Appendix slide: quick action items and owners (3–6 items).

Facilitator script (Standard):
- Opening (30s): "Thanks — we’ll run fast. Goal: alignment on health and agree next steps for renewal."
- When presenting health: call out a single metric early. If trending down, propose immediate mitigation owner and 1-week checkpoint.

2) Enterprise Track (Executive + Technical) — 45–60 minutes
Structure: Start with exec narrative (20 min), then technical deep-dive (20–30 min), finish with decisioning and next steps (5–10 min).

Slide A: Executive One-Pager (single slide)
- Top line: current ARR/commit, 12-month renewal cliff, top 3 strategic outcomes we enable for them
- Business impact statement: quantify value where possible (cost per inference saved, time-to-market improvements)

Slide B: Partnership Health Matrix (1 slide)
- Four quadrants: Adoption, Reliability, Business Impact, Risk. Color code: green/yellow/red.
- Note: use RACI-style owner tags on the slide for each item.

Slide C: Customer Outcomes & Case Studies (1–2 slides)
- Short mini-case: how our feature X decreased turnaround for their product line; include metric before/after

Slide D: Roadmap Alignment & Dependencies (2 slides)
- Map their top 5 asks to our roadmap timeframe + dependency owners
- Include fallback options and SLA implications for enterprise commitments

Slide E: Technical Appendix (3–6 slides, optional breakout)
- Key telemetry: token distribution by endpoint; p50/p95/p99 latencies; model versions in use & active KV cache hit rate
- Deployment topology: hosted vs dedicated vs private and any network KMS notes
- Open engineering requests and estimated time-to-resolution

Slide F: Commercial Proposal Snapshot (1 slide)
- Renewal term recommendation (12/24/36 months), suggested discounts for committed capacity, optional add-ons (SLA, longer log retention)
- Renewal timeline with decision points and sign-off owners

Decisioning rubric (suggested):
- Green: operational health stable + exec alignment + <10% feature gap => proceed to 12mo renewal with recommended expansion
- Yellow: one of the following: >10% feature gap, single outstanding P0 bug unresolved, or usage declining => propose conditional renewal with milestones
- Red: >2 months of repeated incidents or exec disengagement => escalate to AE + Solutions Eng for remediation prior to renewal commitment

Renewal tracker (compact text table — copy into sheet when prepping):
- Columns: account | ARR | renewal_date | owner | recommended_term | risk_level | next_action | due_date
- Example row: "Orion Health | $420,000 | 2025-05-20 | Priya D. | 24m + dedicated pool trial | yellow | schedule technical deep-dive | 2025-02-28"

Playbook: pre-meeting -> meeting -> post-meeting (short checklist)
- Pre-meeting (7–14 days): data pull, 1:1 with AE to confirm ask, slide draft to customer 48h before
- Meeting: timebox agenda, capture parking-lot items for tech breakout, record decisions in meeting notes, confirm sign-off owner and date on final slide
- Post-meeting (24–72h): send deck + action log, update renewal tracker, schedule SLA/contract work if green

Escalation & follow-up templates (snippets):
- Email subject (exec): "Quarterly review outcome & recommended renewal — [Account name]"
- Slack nudge to AE: "Pls confirm exec sponsor availability for decision by [date] — blocking items: [list]"
- Internal escalation note to Solutions Eng: short bulleted summary + urgency tag (P0/P1)

Facilitator tips & anti-patterns:
- Tip: never start with metrics before stating the outcome we want from the meeting.
- Anti-pattern: >5 slides of telemetry up front — bury only what matters for the decision.
- Tip: use one named owner per risk item (don’t use teams).

Handy prep queries (examples for data team):
- usage_last_30_days: SELECT sum(tokens) FROM billing WHERE account_id = ? AND ts >= now()-30d;
- error_rate_7d: count_if(status >= 500)/count(*) WHERE ts >= now()-7d AND account_id = ?;
- active_endpoints_top10: SELECT endpoint, sum(calls) FROM request_log WHERE account_id = ? GROUP BY endpoint ORDER BY sum(calls) DESC LIMIT 10;

Open questions / TODOs in this draft:
- Add a 1-slide ROI calculator for enterprise customers (ask finance for quick template).
- Standardize color palette and icons for health matrix across CS decks.
- Build a 1-click export from tracker to a slide-ready CSV via the internal tooling team.

Quick version control notes: v0.1 initial draft (this doc), v0.2 add finance ROI slide, v0.3 pilot with two accounts (Orion Health, Solara Retail) and iterate.

End notes: keep slides short, bring evidence, name owners. This file is a living draft — please add comments inline and link any relevant playbook updates in Confluence.
